purpose: Four main-character art direction prototypes, not production animation sprites

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original main-character pixel art design prototype for a premium Windows desktop adventure game, Agents Bar. This is a polished art-direction exploration, NOT a generic beginner sprite.
Deliver ONE isolated full-body character only. Square canvas, genuine transparent background. Character centered with generous clean margins, entire silhouette, feet, head, accessories and weapon fully within frame. Camera: orthographic three-quarter view facing right, relaxed alert standing pose with one foot slightly ahead, weapon lowered at rest. No scenery, no pedestal, no UI, no lettering, no labels, no watermark, no inset views.
Medium: exceptionally crafted high-detail 2D game pixel art, approximately 128 by 192 logical pixels for the character, enlarged with sharp nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Deliberate pixel clusters, precise stair-step contours, restrained selective outlines, hand-designed highlight clusters, intentional limited color ramps and rich hue-shifted shadows. Every small square belongs to the design. NO smooth digital painting, no 3D rendering, no blur, no anti-aliased brush strokes, no coarse simplistic block figure, no noisy pixelation filter over a painting.
Shared hero identity where the face is visible: young adult male adventurer, warm olive skin, dark wavy hair with a small pale forelock, expressive amber eyes, a small turquoise diamond-shaped keepsake clasp. Memorable sophisticated silhouette. High production value: convincing anatomy, hands, costume construction, distinct readable materials and carefully balanced details. Lighting from upper left, modeled exclusively in pixel clusters. Design direction 1 of 4: CLASSIC FANTASY KNIGHT, lavishly crafted 1990s/modern premium pixel-RPG protagonist. Adult 5.5-head proportions. Layered fluted silver-blue plate armor, articulated gauntlets and greaves, warm worn leather beneath, understated aged brass trims, sculpted asymmetric shoulder armor, a short burgundy cape with readable stepped folds. Open-faced half-helm revealing the face and forelock. Straight longsword held lowered diagonally beside the body, elegant decorated crossguard, turquoise clasp on the cape. Ceremonial finesse balanced with believable adventuring gear. Rich material shading, heroic but approachable. Specific distinctive design rather than a stock knight.
